spanish: Y también yo he descubierto tus calvas delante de ti; y tus pecados son vistos.

findings.issue: שׁוּלַ֖יִךְ rendered as 'tus calvas' (bald spots) instead of skirts/train of garment
קְלוֹנֵֽךְ rendered as 'tus pecados' (sins) instead of your dishonor/shame

notes: two noun mismatches change the licensed meaning
